title: Cannot disable preemptive restart
symptom: xDrip attempts to preemptively restart a sensor on day 9 despite the user wanting to disable it. The preemptive restart option checkbox is hidden, and the Restart Sensor option is disabled.
cause: The preemptive restart setting 'ob1_g5_preemptive_restart' was still enabled in the settings, likely from a previous transmitter that supported preemptive restarts, even though the UI option is hidden for newer transmitters.
fix: Manually edit the exported settings XML to set 'ob1_g5_preemptive_restart' to false, or enter a made-up serial number starting with '80' to make the option visible in the UI and disable it there.
evidence_quote: Have exported Xdrip settings, I shall manually change the following to false as it is currently true: ob1_g5_preemptive_restart
